item.title: Teaching
item.description: Baruch College, Zicklin School of Business OPM 3400: Operations Management Undergraduate — Spring 2025, Fall 2024 Introduction to the principles and methods of operations management, including process analysis, capacity planning, inventory management, and supply chain design. OPM 4500: Data-Driven Decision Making Undergraduate — Spring 2025 An introduction to data-driven methods for managerial decision-making. Topics include statistical modeling, optimization under uncertainty, and machine learning applications in operations. USC Marshall School of Business (Teaching Assistant) DSO 530: Applied Modern Statistical Learning Methods Graduate — Spring 2022, Spring 2021
